question: What cruise/ship does this dataset belong to? Occurrence records carry a CalCOFI-style locationID and a date (2022-10-13 to 2022-10-18) but no explicit cruise/ship identifier.
context: Needed to resolve sample.cruise_key and ship_key; no cruise/ship id in the DwC-A source.
answer: RESOLVED 2026-09-26: queried the live release (calcofi.io/db-query) for cruise.date_min/date_max overlapping 2022-10-13..18 -- exactly one match, cruise_key='2022-10-33UD', ship_key='RL'. Cross-checked ship_key='RL' against the ship table: ship_name='REUBEN LASKER', ship_nodc='33UD', matching the GBIF/IPT page's stated vessel (NOAA Ship Reuben Lasker) and the cruise_key's own '33UD' suffix. Implemented via resolve_cruise_key() (cce-lter_euphausiids.qmd precedent), not match_by_site_datetime()/match_nearest_by_depth().
